snippet.title: Haunted Paws - Release Month Trailer
snippet.description:
Haunted Paws is launching in May 2027 on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS4, PS5, and Xbox!

WISHLIST HAUNTED PAWS:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2861080/Haunted_Paws/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/haunted-paws-switch
Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/haunted-paws-switch-2
PS4 & PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019880
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/haunted-paws/9n00w4fpcj2v

Free demos are also available now on Steam, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2!

ABOUT HAUNTED PAWS:

A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or online, or invite a friend to play for free with Friend’s Pass!
